Description (<300 chars): Good lighting changes how a room looks and how it works. We install and repair every kind of lighting in Yardley-area homes and small businesses, from recessed lights and chandeliers to under-cabinet, landscape and security lighting, with clean wiring and a finished look.
Replace an outdated or overloaded electrical panel with a modern 200-amp service. We handle the permit, the PECO disconnect and reconnect, the inspection, and label every circuit when we're done.
Add circuits where you need them with a subpanel for a garage, basement, addition or workshop. We check your service capacity first, size the feeder properly and handle the permit and inspection.
Replace an old fuse box with a modern circuit breaker panel, or get a blown fuse changed safely. We make sure every fuse is the right size for its wire and upgrade the service when it's due.
Replace an old fuse box with a modern circuit breaker panel, or get a blown fuse changed safely. We make sure every fuse is the right size for its wire and upgrade the service when it's due.

Breakers that trip for no reason, feel hot or won't reset get diagnosed and replaced with the correct breaker for your panel. We find out why it failed before we swap it, so the problem doesn't come back.

Arc-fault (AFCI) breakers detect the kind of sparking that starts electrical fires inside walls. We install them where code requires, add them during remodels, and track down the cause when one keeps tripping.

Replace knob-and-tube, cloth-insulated or ungrounded wiring in older homes, room by room or all at once. We fish new cable through existing walls wherever we can, so you get new wiring with as little patching as possible.

Homes wired with single-strand aluminum in the 1960s and 70s can overheat at outlets and switches. We make every connection safe with approved copper pigtail connectors, or replace the aluminum wiring entirely.

Level 2 home EV charger installation by a Tesla-certified installer. We check your panel's capacity, run the circuit to your garage or driveway, and install and test chargers for Tesla, Rivian, Ford, Kia and other brands.

A surge protector installed at your electrical panel protects everything in the house, from the furnace and fridge to TVs and computers, against surges from lightning, the utility and your own large appliances.
Bring an older home's electrical system up to how you live now: grounded three-prong outlets, more circuits, USB and GFCI outlets, better lighting and the capacity for modern appliances.
Wiring for kitchen remodels and updates: countertop circuits, GFCI outlets, island power, dedicated appliance circuits, induction and electric ranges, recessed and under-cabinet lighting.

Dead outlets, tripping breakers, flickering lights, buzzing switches and half-working circuits, tracked down methodically and fixed properly. We find the cause instead of guessing, and explain what we found.

A thorough check of your home's electrical system: panel inspection, tightening connections, testing GFCI and AFCI protection, smoke and CO alarms, and a written list of anything that needs attention.

Fix the electrical items on a home inspection or municipal inspection report, from double-tapped breakers and missing GFCIs to open junction boxes and ungrounded outlets, with documentation for buyers and sellers.
Complete electrical for new homes, additions and major renovations: planning, temporary power, service installation, rough-in, trim-out and inspections, coordinated with your builder's schedule.
Add ground wires to ungrounded outlets, repair or replace grounding electrodes and ground rods, and bond water pipes and gas lines, so your outlets, surge protection and electronics work as designed.
New wiring for remodels, additions, attic and basement conversions: circuits, outlets, switches and lighting planned around how you'll use the space, installed to code and inspected.
Give appliances and equipment their own circuit so they stop tripping breakers: microwaves, refrigerators, freezers, sump pumps, space heaters, home offices, gym equipment and 240-volt tools.
Add outlets where you need them and replace worn, loose, cracked or warm switches and outlets. We install USB and tamper-resistant outlets and fix the loose connections behind flickering switches.

Move outlets and switches to where they belong: behind a wall-mounted TV, clear of new cabinets, at the right height, or on the latch side of a door. Old boxes are closed up to code.
Ground-fault (GFCI) protection for kitchens, bathrooms, laundry areas, garages, basements and outdoor outlets. We install GFCI outlets and breakers where code requires and fix GFCIs that won't reset.
Weather-resistant, GFCI-protected outdoor outlets with in-use covers for decks, patios, porches, holiday lights, landscape lighting transformers, pool equipment and yard tools.
LED-compatible dimmers that dim smoothly without flicker or buzz, including smart dimmers, multi-location dimming and dimmers matched to your fixtures and bulbs.
Control a light from two or more places, such as the top and bottom of the stairs or both ends of a hallway. We add new switch locations and fix 3-way circuits that only work one way.

Ceiling fans installed securely on fan-rated boxes, whether you're replacing a light fixture or adding a fan to a room with no ceiling wiring. Separate fan and light control, remotes and high-ceiling downrods.

Powered attic ventilators wired with thermostat and humidistat control to move hot, humid air out of your attic. We install gable fans and wire roof-mounted units, and repair fans that have stopped working.
Circuits and hookups for electric and induction ranges, cooktops, wall ovens, dryers, water heaters, dishwashers, disposals and built-in microwaves, sized to each appliance and wired to code.
Electrical for bathroom remodels and updates: vanity lights, exhaust fans vented to the outside, heated floors, towel warmers, wet-rated shower lights and GFCI-protected outlets.

Wiring for smart switches, dimmers, thermostats, video doorbells, cameras and hubs, including adding neutral wires and power where devices need it, so your smart home is reliable rather than frustrating.

Hardwired, interconnected smoke and carbon monoxide alarms with battery backup, installed where code requires, plus replacement of alarms past their ten-year life and fixes for chirping and false alarms.
Wired and video doorbell installation, new transformers for Ring, Nest and other video doorbells, chime replacement and repair of doorbells that don't ring or keep losing power.
Network (Cat6) cable, thermostat and doorbell wire, speaker wire, TV wall pass-throughs and camera wiring, run neatly and kept a safe distance from power wiring.
Complete hot tub and swim spa wiring: a 240-volt circuit sized to the tub, a GFCI-protected disconnect at the required distance, bonding, the permit and the inspection.
Electrical for in-ground and above-ground pools: pump, filter and heater circuits, pool lighting, equipotential bonding, GFCI protection and the inspections pools require.
Complete electrical for finished basements: circuits, outlets, recessed lighting, AFCI and GFCI protection, smoke alarms, sump pump circuits and a subpanel if your main panel is full.
Power for detached garages, sheds and workshops: underground feeders, subpanels, lighting, outlets, 240-volt tool circuits and EV charger circuits, permitted and inspected.

Electrical for horse barns, pole buildings and agricultural outbuildings: feeders and subpanels, damp- and dust-rated lighting, GFCI-protected outlets, water heater and fan circuits, and old barn wiring replaced safely.
Recessed LED lighting for kitchens, living rooms, basements and baths, laid out for even light without dark spots or glare, on dimmers, and installed in finished ceilings with minimal patching.
Replace dated ceiling fixtures or add a ceiling light to a room that doesn't have one. We check the box and wiring, support heavier fixtures properly and put it on the switch where you want it.
Chandeliers installed safely on supports rated for the weight, hung at the right height over the table or in a two-story foyer, assembled, leveled and put on a dimmer.
Pendant lights over kitchen islands, peninsulas, dining tables and entries, spaced and hung at the right height, with new boxes where they're needed and adapters for sloped ceilings.
Wall sconces beside bathroom mirrors, along hallways and stairs, by the bed and at exterior doors, installed at the right height with new boxes fished into finished walls.
Adjustable track and monorail lighting for artwork, kitchens, sloped ceilings, studios and retail displays, with modern LED heads you can aim, move and dim.
Hardwired LED under-cabinet lighting on a wall switch or dimmer, with the wiring and drivers hidden, so your counters are evenly lit without cords or dark spots.
